questions.question: Which African country is completely surrounded by South Africa?
questions.fun_fact: Lesotho is one of only three sovereign nations in the world to be entirely enclosed by a single other country.

questions.question: What is the hardest natural substance known on Earth?
questions.fun_fact: Diamond ranks a maximum of 10 on the Mohs scale of mineral hardness.

questions.question: Who was the first Emperor of the Roman Empire?
questions.fun_fact: Augustus, originally named Octavian, became the first Roman emperor after the fall of the Roman Republic.

questions.question: Which 1977 epic space opera film introduced characters like Luke Skywalker and Han Solo to the world?
options: Close Encounters of the Third Kind
questions.fun_fact: Star Wars was famously written and directed by George Lucas and became a massive cultural phenomenon.

questions.question: From which country does the famous blue-veined cheese Roquefort originate?
questions.fun_fact: Roquefort cheese is made from the milk of ewes and is aged in the natural caves of the Combalou mountain in France.

questions.question: What is a group of crows commonly called?
questions.fun_fact: The term 'murder of crows' has roots in folklore and the bird's association with death and scavenging.

questions.question: In ten-pin bowling, what term is used when a player knocks down all ten pins with the first roll of a frame?
questions.fun_fact: Achieving twelve consecutive strikes in a single game results in a maximum possible score of 300 points.

questions.question: What is the study of the origin and historical development of words called?
questions.fun_fact: Etymologists trace words back through time by looking at their earliest known uses and structural changes.

questions.question: Which moon of Saturn is famous for possessing a dense nitrogen atmosphere and liquid methane lakes?
questions.fun_fact: Titan is the only object other than Earth known to have stable bodies of surface liquid.

questions.question: What is the noble gas with the atomic number 10, commonly used in bright red advertising signs?
questions.fun_fact: Neon glows a reddish-orange color when electricity is discharged through it in a vacuum tube.
